papers.title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
papers.summary: Publication bias can make deeper biomedical retrieval increase false-positive causal conclusions; a two-layer stopping policy reduces drift in 140 Cochrane-derived queries.
papers.use: Directly relevant to OncoGraph's evidence-depth and null-effect evaluation.
papers.steal: Plot conclusions against retrieval depth on null-effect queries and evaluate stopping policies.
papers.doubt: Do results hold with heterogeneous sources and unpublished negative evidence?

papers.title: Stochastic Flow Map for Count Data
papers.summary: Learns finite-time Poisson-birth and binomial-death transitions directly in count space for few-step generation, including single-cell perturbations.
papers.use: An alternative representation and falsification target for PerturbRx.
papers.steal: Compare latent and count-space transitions on dispersion, zeros, and tails.
papers.doubt: Does cell-level count fidelity transfer to patient drug response after batch and library-size shifts?

papers.title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
papers.authors: Shuaijun Liu, Chengyu Wu, Qifu Wen, Feiyang You, Chenglong Zhang, Shuyang Hao, Xi Lin, Ningxin Su
papers.summary: JEPA latent prediction need not rank executable futures correctly; D-JEPA aligns candidate-future geometry to observed decision outcomes.
papers.use: Separates PerturbRx source-transition fidelity from drug-choice utility.
papers.steal: Evaluate pairwise rank inversions between predicted and realized action outcomes.
papers.doubt: How can decision labels be obtained when patient counterfactual outcomes are unobserved?

papers.title: Causal Bayesian Optimization: Foundations, Methods, and Applications
papers.authors: Chenfeng Huang, Thuy T. Le, Zixuan Ma, Hien Tran
papers.summary: A TMLR survey plus benchmark of causal Bayesian optimization under budgets, intervention types and graph misspecification; no method dominates.
papers.use: Useful for active perturbation selection and Transfer Trust protocols.
papers.steal: Compare against non-causal BO across budgets and misspecified causal graphs.
papers.doubt: Could uncertain biomedical KG edges create misleading apparent gains?

papers.title: Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions
papers.summary: A controlled 162-run benchmark shows high aggregate single-cell accuracy can hide rare-class failures, some not repaired by long-tail losses.
papers.steal: Separate low-support groups by recoverability and report precision, recall and embedding geometry.
papers.doubt: Does cell-type classification behavior generalize to patient drug-response cohorts?

papers.title: Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written
papers.summary: Equivalent absolute and delta action encodings can yield sharply different robot-world-model predictions and choices.
papers.use: Motivates action-encoding invariance tests for drug/dose-conditioned transitions.
papers.steal: Test equivalent intervention encodings for vector and ranking agreement.
papers.doubt: Does the result reproduce for dose reparameterizations under matched training support?

papers.title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
papers.authors: Hongqiang Lin, Chao Liu, Xiaofan Bai, Xuan Jin, Yuhong Li, Nenggan Zheng, Xipeng Cao
papers.summary: EvoPathBench freezes evolving agent artifacts at checkpoints and tests generalization, retention and rule adaptation on held-out tasks.
papers.use: An evaluation design for evolving research and KG agents.
papers.steal: Version agent memories/skills and rerun held-out capability tests after each update.
papers.doubt: Can trading-domain capability units map cleanly to scientific research?

papers.title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
papers.authors: Jeremy Cerwin Wang, Wai Kit Wong, Jeff Kai Tai Tang
papers.summary: A plan-retrieve-derive GRPO objective scores visual evidence, intermediate derivations and final answers separately.
papers.use: Transfers to process-level scoring of OncoGraph multi-hop answers.
papers.steal: Separate evidence, reasoning-edge and answer rewards.
papers.doubt: Can deterministic document traces transfer to uncertain biomedical evidence?

papers.title: CurvFlow-DTA: dual-graph discrete Ricci curvature flow for drug--target affinity prediction
papers.authors: Jicheng Ma, Yunyan Yang, Juan Zhao, Liang Zhao
papers.summary: Applies pair-conditioned curvature-flow horizons to molecule and protein-contact graphs for affinity prediction with warm and cold-start evaluation.
papers.use: Relevant to drug-target transfer and protein-family holdouts.
papers.steal: Test multiscale pair-adaptive geometry on family-disjoint splits.
papers.doubt: Do estimated contact graphs and similar sequences leak into cold-start evaluation?

papers.title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
papers.authors: Minda Zhao, Fangyu Hu, Yan Luo, Yutong Yang, Jiahui Cai, Kaichen Zhou, Manling Li, Paul Liang, Yilun Du, Lucy Q. Shen, Mengyu Wang
papers.summary: Training-free, frozen-encoder retrieval selects query-aligned medical examples for multimodal ICL; six aligned examples outperform many random ones.
papers.use: Relevant to evidence selection in biomedical retrieval.
papers.steal: Ablate alignment to both case content and question intent.
papers.doubt: Does similarity-based selection suppress counterexamples in literature search?
